title: KJSEA Assessment Registration (2026)
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Are you a learner, parent or registering institution?

claims.text: The 2026 KJSEA/KPLEA registration window was 2 March to 31 March 2026; it is historical.
KJSEA registration is not automatic. Requirements include the Grade 9 database entry, KPSEA performance or equivalent, and Grade 7 and 8 school-based assessment scores.
The KJSEA institutional declaration verifies candidate names, assessment numbers and subject entries, including special-needs and religious-education options. It is forwarded through the SCDE.

The KJSEA special-needs form requires institutional and medical evidence identifying assistance; its notes specify recent detailed medical and EARC reports for listed categories and a full-size photograph for physical disability. Low-vision candidates also require a medical report.
